WITH sma_10004_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , case when status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end AS __cancelled_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_8.cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
  , MAX(subq_15.cancel_rate) AS cancel_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
  FROM sma_10004_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__cancelled_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  FROM sma_10004_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15

在青禾当前测试库范围内，2026 年 8 月（2026-08-01 至 2026-09-01）的订单统计如下：

- 取消订单数：2 单（按原订单下单日期归属于 8 月的状态为 cancelled 订单）
- 取消率：6.25%（取消订单数除以创建订单数）
